headline: A 2016 law renamed a New Orleans post office building after Daryle Holloway.
what_it_does: This law gives a specific Postal Service building at 5919 Chef Menteur Highway in New Orleans, Louisiana, the official name "Daryle Holloway Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 13, 2016.
